pdf_script = '''import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the Word document
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Create a new PDF
pdf = fitz.open()

# Page settings
page_width = 595  # A4 width in points
page_height = 842  # A4 height in points
margin_left = 50
margin_right = 50
margin_top = 50
margin_bottom = 50
usable_width = page_width - margin_left - margin_right

# Font sizes
title_size = 16
subtitle_size = 13
body_size = 10
line_spacing = 1.4

y = margin_top
page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)

def new_page_if_needed(y_pos, needed=30):
    global page, y
    if y_pos + needed > page_height - margin_bottom:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y = margin_top
        return margin_top
    return y_pos

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        y += body_size * 0.5
        continue

    # Determine style
    style_name = para.style.name.lower() if para.style else ""
    if "title" in style_name or "heading 1" in style_name:
        font_size = title_size
        font_name = "helv"
        bold = True
    elif "heading" in style_name or "subtitle" in style_name:
        font_size = subtitle_size
        font_name = "helv"
        bold = True
    else:
        font_size = body_size
        font_name = "helv"
        bold = False

    # Word wrap
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current_line = ""
    for word in words:
        test_line = current_line + (" " if current_line else "") + word
        # Approximate character width
        char_width = font_size * 0.5
        if len(test_line) * char_width > usable_width:
            if current_line:
                lines.append(current_line)
            current_line = word
        else:
            current_line = test_line
    if current_line:
        lines.append(current_line)

    for line in lines:
        y = new_page_if_needed(y, font_size * line_spacing + 5)
        text_point = fitz.Point(margin_left, y + font_size)
        fontname = "hebo" if bold else "helv"
        page.insert_text(text_point, line, fontsize=font_size, fontname=fontname)
        y += font_size * line_spacing

    y += font_size * 0.3  # paragraph spacing

output_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
pdf.save(output_path)
pdf.close()
print(f"PDF saved to {output_path}")
print(f"Pages: {fitz.open(output_path).page_count}")
'''
